title: AuthoringConversationView
description: 200 response body of GET /api/authoring/conversations/:id (HEL-397 design.md D7) — the display-only subset a reloaded chat surface needs to rehydrate a visible thread. RLS-scoped to the owner; 404 for a missing or non-owned id. The server-internal apiHistory (the raw Claude conversation shape) never leaves the server — it is not part of this shape.

conversationId.description: The id supplied in the request path, echoed back.

displayTurns.description: One entry per turn so far — a user turn's own typed text verbatim, or a deterministic "Proposed \"<name>\" (<n> panel(s))" summary for an assistant turn (never raw model JSON).

latestProposal.description: The current working proposal — what "review & apply" hands off. Always present for a real conversation id in practice (a conversation row is only ever created once a turn has already succeeded).
